name: com.royalthrone.match3-vfx
description: Pooled match-3 feedback extracted from Royal Throne: swap, invalid-swap, fall and landing motion; staged match pops with sparkle bursts and sprite shatter; rocket, TNT, helicopter and colour-orb sequences with per-cell hit callbacks; camera shake, hit-stop, capped SFX and a combo banner. Game rules stay in your project through IMatch3VfxHost and IMatch3Board.

samples.description: Self-contained 8x8 board that previews every effect. No art or game code required.

samples.displayName: Royal Throne Art and SFX Pack
samples.description: Royal Throne power-up sprites, painted burst chips, smoke puff, mastered SFX and a preconfigured settings asset.
Host, board and bridge for projects built on the JellyGarden match-3 code base (Item, Square, LevelManager).
